title: zeltnera arizonica
intro: Zeltnera arizonica, commonly known as Arizona penstemon or Arizona penstemon beardtongue, is a perennial plant species native to the southwestern United States. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Zeltnera arizonica include its potential to treat respiratory issues, coughs, and sore throats, with its therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and bronchodilatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Zeltnera arizonica include iridoid glycosides, such as aucubin and catalpol, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
